question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Final query: Top 3 revenue-generating films for each actor, with average revenue per actor
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM film f
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        fr.total_revenue * 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fr.film_id) as actor_revenue
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        film_id,
        title,
        total_revenue,
        ROUND(actor_revenue, 2) as actor_revenue
    FROM actor_film_revenue
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY actor_revenue DESC) <= 3
)
SELECT 
    actor_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    film_id,
    title,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(actor_revenue, 2) as actor_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(actor_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id), 2) as avg_actor_revenue
FROM ranked
ORDER BY actor_id, actor_revenue DESC
